notes: OLED protection now actually works, and has a control in Panel Settings. It was not working before: the setting has been saved and restored for many versions, and the app still carried the code to receive a screen-shift instruction, but…

Colour settings now show the colour in use. The swatches always displayed black, because a colour control accepts only a full six-digit hex value and these settings are unset by default, meaning follow the theme. They now show the theme…
Removed Size units from the OG Widget. It is a full-screen panel concept and does not apply to a resizable widget; the panels it does apply to still have it.
